decisions.evidence: R1 maker (spec gate): assumes 'No rich metadata (thumbnails, favicons, previews) beyond a basic derived title' and asks 'must-have features... favicons/previews?'. R1 client: 'Saving a link should automatically collect its title, description, favicon, and preview image... So yes to favicons and previews.'
decisions.note: Prototype/spec gate. Draft explicitly excluded auto-metadata (REF-BM-02) and offered inclusion as a choice; client selected the reference-conforming option, so diverged=true with catch_type=select.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: P3 'edit titles/tags' only. R1 client: 'I should be able to edit the address, title, description, tags, and a note.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Presented edit scope was partial (titles/tags); client supplies the full reference field set (url/title/description/tags/note) — correct.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: FR includes 'duplicate detection'. R1 client: 'Saving an address that already exists should take me to the existing bookmark to edit it, not merely reject it as a duplicate.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Mere duplicate detection/rejection mismatches REF-BM-06 (guide to edit existing); client supplies the reference behaviour — correct.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'shown in a list', no favicons (rich metadata excluded). R1 client: 'The list should clearly show each bookmark's title, description, tags, and favicon.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Draft list rows lacked description/favicon (favicons excluded); client supplies reference row content — correct.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: no tag autocomplete in draft. R1 client: 'Tag entry should suggest tags I already use.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Reference requirement (tag autocomplete) missing from presented scope; client requests it — extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'search across title/address/tags'. R1 client: 'Search should be case-insensitive and cover the title, description, note, and address. I also want #tag searches, exact quoted phrases, and combinations using AND, OR, NOT, and parentheses.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Basic search diverged from reference semantics (note field, case-insensitivity, #tag, phrases, boolean/parentheses); client supplies the full reference search behaviour — correct.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: no read-later in draft. R1 client: 'I need a read-later state, a separate unread view, and a way to mark items read.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Read-later/unread-view/mark-read absent from presented scope; client requests these reference requirements — extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: no bulk actions in draft. R1 client: 'I should be able to select several bookmarks—or everything matching my current search or filter—and add or remove tags, mark read or unread, archive, or delete them.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Bulk-action requirements missing from presented scope; client requests them — extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: no sorting in draft. R1 client: 'I need sorting, including by date added and title.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Sort requirement missing; client requests it — extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: no archiving in draft. R1 client: 'Archiving should be reversible and separate from permanent deletion, with archived items hidden from normal lists and searches and available in their own view.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Archive-vs-delete and archive view missing; client requests these reference requirements — extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: no saved filters in draft. R1 client: 'I want saved combinations of searches and included or excluded tags that I can revisit.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Bundle/saved-search requirement missing; client requests it — extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: no note formatting in draft. R1 client: 'Notes should support basic formatting and display properly.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Note requirement absent in R1; client requests it — extend. (Distinct from the R2 markdown-vs-rich-text correction below, per same-requirement-different-point.)

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: no page preservation in draft. R1 client: 'I want a preserved copy of a bookmarked page, including saving the original file when the link is a PDF, plus an option to preserve it through the Internet Archive.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Preservation (local copy, PDF handling, Internet Archive) missing; client requests these reference requirements — extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: assumes 'No import/export from browsers or files in v1' and asks 'import from browser, export?'. R1 client: 'Import and export in the common browser-bookmark HTML format are must-haves, preserving titles, tags, and dates when importing... yes to import/export.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Draft excluded import/export and offered it as a choice; client selected the reference-conforming option — select.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: no display preferences in draft. R1 client: 'Basic display preferences such as default sorting, number of items shown, and text size should be included.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Preferences requirement missing; client requests it — extend.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker: 'Formatted notes | Basic rich-text' and assumption ''Basic note formatting' = bold/italic/lists/links'. R2 client: 'Notes should use Markdown for formatting, rather than a rich-text editor.'
decisions.note: Specification gate (revision). R2 presented rich-text, diverging from REF-BM-23 (markdown); client supplies the reference-conforming form — correct.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker: 'On save, fetches title, description...' and 'Editable fields | Address, title, description, tags, note' — no before-initial-save adjustment stated. R2 client: 'I should be able to adjust the automatically collected title and description before the initial save, as well as later.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. R2 omitted the before-save editing timing of REF-BM-03; client supplies the reference behaviour — correct.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker: 'Page preservation | Viewable saved copy; original file kept for PDFs'. R2 client: 'A preserved web page should be stored as a self-contained local HTML file. If the address is a PDF, preserve the original PDF instead.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. R2's generic 'saved copy' under-specified vs REF-BM-24 (single self-contained HTML); client pins it to the reference form — correct.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker search row lists '#tag, "exact phrases", AND/OR/NOT/parentheses' without stating tag+text combination or quoted-operator rule. R2 client: 'When ordinary search text and a #tag appear together, both should have to match. Also, quoted words such as "AND" should be treated as literal words rather than operators.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. R2 omitted the tag+text AND-combination edge case and REF-BM-15's quoted-operator-literal rule; client supplies both reference rules — correct.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker: 'Bulk actions | Select several or all-matching-search'. R2 client: '"Select all matching" should respect the complete current view, including its search, tag filters, and whether I'm viewing unread or archived items—not merely the visible page.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. R2's 'all-matching-search' was narrower than REF-BM-21 edge case (whole current-filter scope: search + tag filters + perspective); client supplies the reference scope — correct.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Save a bookmark (P1) — paste a link... validated, stored'. R1 client accepts save-by-URL as-is (focuses corrections elsewhere).
decisions.note: Spec gate. Save-by-URL conforms to REF-BM-01; recorded conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'delete with confirmation'. Client raises no objection to delete itself.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Delete conforms to REF-BM-05; recorded conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'open a bookmark in the browser'. Client accepts opening behaviour.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Open-original-url conforms to REF-BM-08; recorded conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'optionally a title/tags', 'tagging/filtering'. Client accepts tag assignment (only adds autocomplete request, counted separately).
decisions.note: Spec gate. Assigning tags conforms to REF-BM-09; recorded conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'group by tags and filter'. Client accepts tag filtering.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Filter-by-tag conforms to REF-BM-11; recorded conforming decision.
